name: Gujarat Pipavav Port Limited
summary: Gujarat Pipavav Port Limited engages in the construction, operation, and maintenance of port at Pipavav in Gujarat, India. The company provides port services, including marine, berth hire, wharfage, yard operation, stevedorage, and other services. Its port handles bulk and break-bulk cargo comprising coal, cement, clinker, fertilizers, steel, iron ore, agri-products, salt, and soda ash; dry bulk cargo; and liquid cargo, including LPG, POL, chemicals, vegetable oils, bitumen, etc., as well as offers roll-on roll-off, towage, maritime personnel, and storage and warehousing services. It also offers buffer yard facilities, containers, container freight station, and inland transportation solution…
